segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Describe low point -> introduce high benchmark -> detail obsessive work effort -> reveal first product milestone.

segmentPatterns.label: Thematic Quote Anchor

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Static or floating cover graphic paired with metadata and active audio waveform.

segmentPatterns.label: Artwork Close-up Dissection

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Macro zoom and directional pan across key thematic motifs in the artwork.

segmentPatterns.label: Direct Archival Confession Hold
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Subject explains personal dilemma and motivation in their own words.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Sustained interview clip without intrusive motion graphics or cuts.

segmentPatterns.label: Collaborator Testimony to Narrative Pivot

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Archival partner stills -> multi-cam interview snippet -> abrupt host cut.

segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Complication introduced -> firsthand testimonial proof -> artistic pivot and album release -> musical breakdown.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Host exposition -> archival incident imagery -> direct subject interview hold -> artwork reveal -> music player / performance b-roll.

segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Announces milestone mixtape -> names defining track -> explains distinctive production.

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Display motion graphic card with album artwork, track title, and responsive animated audio waveform.

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Juxtapose bright, saturated early video footage against dark silhouette performance lighting.

segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Voiceover stops or steps aside to present a direct musical excerpt.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Clean graphic frame featuring album cover art, typographic track metadata, and reactive audio visualizer.

segmentPatterns.label: Verbal Testimonial Paired with Known Artifact
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claim states that a prominent figure confirmed or referenced a famous event.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Split-screen placing speaking footage on one side and the referenced photographic evidence on the other.

segmentPatterns.label: Thematic Shift Through Atmospheric Metaphor
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narration pivots from superficial exterior glamour to inward grief or darkness.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: High-energy footage abruptly cuts to dark, low-tempo symbolic shots (funerals, rain, isolation).

segmentPatterns.label: Direct Host Thesis Anchor
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Editorial claim or rhetorical turn requiring definitive authority.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Medium close-up host delivery on studio set, cutting directly to or from archival proof.

segmentPatterns.label: Catalogue Density Demonstration
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Asserting vast creative output, continuous volume, or sustained career longevity.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A rapid vertical scrolling strip followed by a structured matrix grid displaying numerous assets.

segmentPatterns.label: Peer Influence Montage
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claiming the subject influenced an entire category, peer group, or generation.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Rapid montage of third-party subjects adopting the protagonist's mannerisms or techniques.

segmentPatterns.label: Host Thesis to Sourced Proof Loop
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Host poses evaluative thesis, cuts to mood/archive evidence, then returns to host for synthesis.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A/B alternating between studio talking head and relevant subject footage.

segmentPatterns.label: Influence Network Pop-In Gallery
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narrator lists multiple descendants/beneficiaries of subject's style.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Clean high-key canvas popping in individual portraits forming an interrelated cluster.

segmentPatterns.label: Grainy Archival Origin Contrast
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Narrator contrasts present high status with low-tech, unglamorous early training.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Camcorder-era studio tape directly illustrating early uncompensated work.

segmentPatterns.label: Direct Uncut Takeaway Address
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Extended philosophical synthesis or thematic moral takeaway.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Continuous static medium portrait holding eye contact without cutaway B-roll.

segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Connecting core thesis themes directly to symbolic physical artifacts.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Macro beauty shots timed tightly to physical descriptions, intercut with presenter.
